knimeNode.name: Archive
knimeNode.shortDescription: Remembers Pareto solutions or replaced DE parents across the optimization.

fullDescription.intro: Best Pareto solutions mode automatically retains feasible nondominated candidates. Replaced DE parents mode maintains the donor archive required by SHADE and L-SHADE. Problem objectives, directions, and constraints are read automatically from Problem Setup.

ports.inPort: Archive returned by the previous loop. Leave disconnected on the first use.
Evaluated Pareto candidates or parents rejected by Elitism.
Connect for L-SHADE so archive capacity follows the shrinking population.
ports.outPort: Updated archive for analysis or the next loop.
